title: Open a file in TextMate
summary: Use the `mate` command to open files in the TextMate editor from the Terminal. You can open one or more files, or specify the file type if it's not recognized automatically.

steps.explain: Run the `mate` command followed by the path to the file you want to edit. You can list multiple files separated by spaces.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file(s) you want to open in TextMate.

alternatives.explain: If TextMate doesn't recognize the file type, you can force it to use a specific syntax highlighting mode.
Open the file and position the cursor at a specific line and column (format: line:column).

placeholders.name: LINE
placeholders.description: The line number to jump to.

placeholders.name: COLUMN
placeholders.description: The column number to jump to.
